experience.objective: Understand shared Environment structure and manage independent Scene content without accidental cross-Scene changes
experience.visibleOutcome: A Creator creates The Haunted Bedroom, authors three independent Scenes, switches, duplicates, renames, saves and reviews explicit Environment revision impacts
experience.integrationOwner: Parallax SC-01 Environment and Scene Manager
experience.accessibility: Native dialog focus containment, explicit labels, visible focus, keyboard entry/Escape and responsive layout preserve the full creation and review workflow.
experience.fallback: When 3D rendering is unavailable, the canonical Scene hierarchy, inspector, content-derived gallery and Guided preview remain available.
experience.navigation: Creator Library opens Spatial Studio. Manage Scenes opens one contextual gallery. Closing returns to the same active Scene and canvas; Creator Studio returns to the Library.
experience.designTarget: Keep the shared Environment and active Scene visible once in a compact context above the canvas. One focused modal manages independent Scenes with content-derived thumbnails, descriptions, save state and explicit immutable version selection. Shared edits open the existing Environment workspace for that same owned definition; built-ins create an owned copy. Working autosave, explicit Library membership and immutable release remain distinct. Revision impact is reviewed per Scene, preserves Undo, identifies changed supports or semantic references, and never rewrites a released Scene. Preserve the blue Studio palette, native modal focus containment, usable narrow controls, reduced motion and natural return to the same Scene.

limitations: Synthetic geometry and browser evidence do not establish physical reconstruction accuracy, native AR rendering or owner product acceptance. Existing SC-02 element consumers retain their own qualification; SC-03 Chronicle editor integration is outside this task.
